name: Triveria ID
summary: Credential type template for urn:triveria.io:id:1, the Triveria company badge in sd_jwt_vc format. Subject form groups: Personal Information (firstName, familyName), Company Information (companyName, companyRole) and Document (serialNumber, dateOfIssue, dateOfExpiry, issuingAuthority). Issued and verified by the NOOP Triveria Organization wallet template.
